text: dsh-chat-sessions 是一个适用于 DSH 网页客户端的独立会话插件，可让用户不先选择项目工作区就开始对话。它在 DSH 会话服务中创建独立会话目录，并在工作区选择器中加入独立对话入口，再通过标题链接和原生工作区接入侧栏。主要功能包括一键创建独立对话、为新会话提供工作目录、按标题整理会话文件入口，以及沿用原生侧栏的置顶、归档和恢复操作。适合希望快速开始临时问答或小型任务、又想让任务文件分开管理的 DSH 用户。默认无需 API 密钥；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.3.0 之前版本。

dsh-chat-sessions adds standalone chats to DSH's web client, with a working directory per new chat. Choose the standalone entry in the workspace picker, then manage chats through the native sidebar. It also organizes files by title and maintains session links and workspaces. No API key is needed.

dsh-chat-sessions 的功能「独立对话创建」：从工作区选择器选择独立对话后，插件通过 DSH 会话服务创建新的会话和工作目录，并可切换到该会话。
dsh-chat-sessions 的功能「标题文件入口」：会话标题会转换为适合文件系统使用的名称，并作为根目录下的相对链接，指向会话目录，便于按聊天标题找到文件。
dsh-chat-sessions 的功能「原生侧栏会话管理」：独立会话接入 DSH 原生工作区和侧栏，可继续使用宿主提供的会话切换、置顶、归档与恢复操作。
dsh-chat-sessions 的功能「独立目录维护」：插件定期同步会话标题链接和工作区归属；启动时只回收已归档且无未归档会话共享的自有空目录。
我希望临时问题和项目聊天各用各的文件目录。
I need standalone chats to appear in the regular session sidebar.

--- 一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：一键新建自带独立工作区的会话，让日常问答和小型任务无需手动选择项目目录即可开始，同时各个会话产生的文件不会相互影响。外观与交互贴近 DSH 原生侧栏，融入现有的会话操作习惯。

dsh-chat-sessions README · 功能：| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **一键开始，工作区独立** | 一键新建自带独立工作区的对话，各自存放任务产生的文件，不同任务互不混杂，无需先手动选择项目目录。 |
| **现有的会话操作习惯** | 交互方式与原版 DSH 保持一致，切换、置顶、归档与恢复等操作沿用熟悉的方式，上手无需重新适应。 |
| **文件管理，方便查找** | 按会话标题整理文件入口，方便找到某次对话中产生的文件，随时查看、编辑或继续使用。 |

dsh-chat-sessions README · Requirements：宿主要求：DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，开发与测试基线为 `0.2.2-rc.1`。

dsh-chat-sessions README · 安装：当前版本 **v0.1.1**：[GitHub Release](https://github.com/ZSQBFan/dsh-chat-sessions/releases/tag/v0.1.1)。

1. 从 Release 下载 `dsh-chat-sessions-0.1.1.tgz`（另附 SHA256 校验文件）。
2. 在 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」中填写下载文件的绝对路径，安装并启用；按宿主提示重新加载或重启。

`main` 分支用于后续开发，固定版本请使用对应 Release 的安装包。

dsh-chat-sessions README · 注意事项：- **升级**：保留原有 `root` 配置。更改存放位置不会自动迁移旧数据；旧版已归档的会话可从原生归档列表手动恢复。
- **归档**：v0.1.1 的空白对话由用户手动归档，启动或重新启用插件时也会保留。归档和恢复使用原生会话菜单及归档列表；归档会取消置顶，恢复后可重新置顶。
- **启动回收**：插件启动或重新启用时，只回收已经归档、没有未归档会话共享的自有空目录（允许仅有 `.DS_Store`）。此操作保留归档状态和会话日志；非空目录保留。
- **工作目录**：房间位于 `<root>/.sessions/`，标题链接只是文件入口。新房间有独立工作区与目录，派生或后续会话可能共享该目录；独立目录不等于系统沙箱。
- **后台维护**：约每 15 秒同步标题链接和工作区归属。未发送草稿保存在浏览器中。
- **停用与备份**：通过 DSH 插件页面停用、再次启用或卸载。停用后可能显露底层工作区，房间、日志和已有工作区保留；本版没有自动停用回收或多会话房间退出管理功能。备份时同时保留房间文件和 DSH 的会话、工作区及归档记录。

dsh-chat-sessions README · 配置：默认配置即可使用。完整的配置项、默认值、取值范围及示例见[配置参考](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)，包括存放位置、侧栏分组、动效、视觉标记、工作区名称和实验选项。

旧版 `idleMs` 已停用，保留旧配置也不会生效。

dsh-chat-sessions README · 开发检查：<details>
<summary>开发环境与检查命令</summary>

需要 Node 22 及以上；CI 使用 Node 22。`npm ci` 安装开发依赖后：

- `npm run check`：包结构、导出、patch 与语法检查。
- `npm test`：文件系统、DOM 与行为测试，只用开发依赖，不需要原生 DSH 包。
- `npm run test:native`：原生侧栏投影契约，需本机已安装 DSH，并用 `DSH_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_CLIENT` 指向它的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js`。

`check-*-browser.mjs` 是需要用浏览器手动打开的夹具，不包含在 `npm test` 内；其中成员位移夹具也需设置 `DSH_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_CLIENT`（或 `HARNESS_ROWS_SOURCE`）。CI 配置见 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`。

</details>

dsh-chat-sessions README · 兼容与反馈：主要在 macOS 的 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 环境使用和验证，其他平台与版本尚待验证。插件依赖原生侧栏结构，DSH 更新后可能需要适配。

这是个人维护项目，按实际使用情况更新。遇到问题请到 [Issues](https://github.com/ZSQBFan/dsh-chat-sessions/issues) 附上 DSH 版本、系统和复现步骤；截图或日志请先移除私人内容。

dsh-chat-sessions README · Introduction：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that creates a chat with its own workspace in one click. Start everyday questions and small tasks without manually choosing a project directory. Its appearance and interactions follow the native DSH sidebar, fitting into the way you already manage sessions.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **One click, a workspace of its own** | Start a chat with its own workspace in one click. Files from different tasks stay in separate working directories, without having to choose a project directory first. |
| **Familiar session controls** | Interactions follow native DSH. Switch, pin, archive, and restore chats the way you already know, with no new workflow to learn. |
| **Files that are easy to find** | File shortcuts are organized by chat title, making it easy to find the files created in a conversation and open, edit, or reuse them later. |

dsh-chat-sessions README · Requirements：Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`; developed and tested against `0.2.2-rc.1`.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Installation：Current version: **v0.1.1**, available from [GitHub Release](https://github.com/ZSQBFan/dsh-chat-sessions/releases/tag/v0.1.1).

1. Download `dsh-chat-sessions-0.1.1.tgz` from the Release (a SHA256 checksum file is included separately).
2. In DSH's plugin page, choose “Add plugin”, enter the downloaded file's absolute path, install, and enable it. Reload or restart as prompted by the host.
dsh-chat-sessions README · Installation：The `main` branch is for continued development. For a fixed version, use the package attached to its Release.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Notes：- **Upgrading**: keep your existing `root` configuration. Changing the storage location does not migrate existing data. Chats already archived by an older version can be restored manually from the native archived list.
- **Archiving**: in v0.1.1, archive blank chats manually; they also remain available when the plugin starts or is re-enabled. Archive and restore through the native session menu and archived list. Archiving removes a pin; pin the chat again after restoring if needed.
- **Startup cleanup**: when the plugin starts or is re-enabled, it only reclaims owned empty directories that are already archived and have no unarchived session sharing them (`.DS_Store` alone is allowed). Archive flags and session logs remain intact; nonempty directories remain.
- **Working directories**: rooms live under `<root>/.sessions/`; title links are file shortcuts. A new room gets its own workspace and directory, while derived or subsequent sessions may share that directory. A separate directory is not a system sandbox.
- **Background maintenance**: title links and workspace membership synchronize roughly every 15 seconds. Unsent drafts live in the browser.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Configuration：Defaults work for normal use. See the [configuration reference](docs/CONFIGURATION.en.md) for every setting, default, accepted value, and an example, including storage, sidebar grouping, motion, visual markers, workspace labels, and experimental options.

The former `idleMs` setting is retired; leaving it in an existing configuration has no effect.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Development checks：<details>
<summary>Development environment and check commands</summary>

Node 22 or newer; CI uses Node 22. After `npm ci`:

- `npm run check`: package structure, exports, patch, and syntax.
- `npm test`: filesystem, DOM, and behaviour tests; development dependencies only, no native DSH packages.
- `npm run test:native`: native sidebar projection contract; needs DSH installed locally, with `DSH_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_CLIENT` pointing at its `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js`.

dsh-chat-sessions README · Development checks：`check-*-browser.mjs` are fixtures you open in a browser by hand and are not part of `npm test`; the membership fixture also needs `DSH_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_CLIENT` (or `HARNESS_ROWS_SOURCE`). CI is defined in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

</details>

dsh-chat-sessions README · Compatibility and feedback：Primarily used and validated on macOS with DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. Other platforms and versions remain unverified. The plugin depends on the native sidebar structure and may need adaptation after DSH updates.

This is a personally maintained project, updated as needs arise. Report problems through [Issues](https://github.com/ZSQBFan/dsh-chat-sessions/issues), including your DSH version, operating system, and reproduction steps. Remove private content from screenshots and logs first.
